instruction: Resize my photo to 800 by 600 pixels.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully enhanced color vibrancy by opening Colors > Hue-Saturation, setting saturation to +40, applying changes, and exporting the image. Completed in 12 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate GIMP menus, use Colors adjustment dialogs (Hue-Saturation), set numeric values, enable preview, export images via File > Export As
metadata.task_rationale: Since the model proved it can navigate GIMP menus and apply adjustments, this variation tests a different GIMP operation (Image > Scale Image) requiring similar menu navigation skills.
metadata.explanation: Task requires resizing the image to 800x600 via Image > Scale Image. Postconfig exports the current GIMP state as resized_photo.png. Evaluator uses official check_image_size metric to verify dimensions match expected 800x600.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter (vm_file) correctly fetches the exported image from /home/user/Desktop/resized_photo.png
Postconfig correctly exports the current GIMP canvas state using Shift+Ctrl+E (Export As), types filename, and confirms export with Enter presses
Metric (check_image_size) correctly receives the rules dict {width: 800, height: 600} and checks both dimensions against expected values
Expected values (800x600) exactly match the instruction requirement 'Resize my photo to 800 by 600 pixels'
Complete coverage: the single instruction requirement (resize to 800x600) is fully verified by checking both width and height
